# Mermaid (vendored)

`mermaid.min.js` here is the file `dist/mermaid.min.js` of the npm package `mermaid`, unchanged.
The studio draws diagrams with it in its own browser (`render_diagram`); it is never sent to a page.

| | |
|---|---|
| Package | `mermaid` 11.15.0, https://www.npmjs.com/package/mermaid (source: https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid) |
| File | `dist/mermaid.min.js`, 3,312,967 bytes |
| SHA-256 | `70137e77bb273bb2ef972b86e8b0400cca8be53cb25bfc45911a186dc98665de` (the same in https://registry.npmjs.org/mermaid/-/mermaid-11.15.0.tgz) |
| Licence | MIT. The full text is in `LICENSE` beside this file |

The version is written in code once: `MERMAID_VERSION` in `server/studio2_server/diagram.py`. To
change it, replace both files here, update this note and that constant, and run the diagram tests.
